chunks: Who persevere and place their trust in their Lord.
ai.seo_question: What are the two main spiritual traits mentioned in this verse regarding believers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the perfect balance between human effort (sabr) and divine dependence (tawakkul), reflecting the state of the Ahl al-Bayt during times of tribulation. It emphasizes that true patience is not passive endurance but an active, conscious reliance on Allah’s decree, serving as a model for believers navigating worldly trials.
